## Description {#details}

<ParametersList title="Template Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="T">The floating point type (e.g., float, double).</ParametersListItem>
<ParametersListItem name="N">The integral part of the constant value.</ParametersListItem>
<ParametersListItem name="D">The fractional part of the constant value.</ParametersListItem>
<ParametersListItem name="Size">The number of decimal digits for the fractional part.</ParametersListItem>
<ParametersListItem name="P">The sign of the value (1 for positive, -1 for negative). Defaults to 1.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>
The <code><Link to="/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/type-traits/floating-point-constant">floating&#95;point&#95;constant</Link></code> struct template provides a compile-time constant value of a floating point type, supporting custom size and precision. It inherits from <code>op</code> to enable unified handling within the µTest++ framework&#39;s type traits and metaprogramming utilities.

This struct template exposes the constant value via a static member, a getter method, and explicit conversion operators. It also provides a unary minus operator to obtain the negative value as a new <code><Link to="/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/type-traits/floating-point-constant">floating&#95;point&#95;constant</Link></code> instance. The <code>epsilon</code> member defines the precision used for floating point comparisons, calculated based on the specified size.
